examples.name: Default
examples.summary: `Field` + `Field.Label` + `Input` + `Field.Description`. The label targets the input and the input is described by the description — no ids to wire.

examples.name: DescriptionAndError
examples.summary: State lives on the `Field`: `required` shows the label's Required marker and sets `required` on the input; `invalid` sets `aria-invalid`. `Field.Error` is announced through `aria-describedby` next to the description.

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.summary: `orientation="horizontal"` puts a `Checkbox` or `Switch` beside a `Field.Content` that stacks its label and description.

examples.name: ChoiceCard
examples.summary: A `Field.Label` wrapping a horizontal `Field` becomes a selectable card: the whole card toggles the control and takes the selected tokens while it is checked. Replaces the v5 `field-checkbox-block`, `field-radio-block` and `field-switch-block`.

examples.name: Fieldset
examples.summary: `Field.Set` + `Field.Legend` group related fields; a nested set with `kind="label"` groups a radio choice. `Field.Group` stacks the fields and `Field.Separator` divides them.

examples.name: InputGroup
examples.summary: An `InputGroup` inside a `Field`: `InputGroup.Input` picks up the field's id, description and state like any other control.
